region.finding: Actually inspected all 24 enlarged source/battle face and complete-body front/side sheets: all 13 clips at six phases. Magma Hyena lower lip, tooth bar and side jaw shear relative to the eyes and nose during idle_2, jump, hit, death and victory head tilts, pulling into the chest mane. Both assets reproduce the defect. Four legs, paws, torso, mane silhouette and short tail remain coherent. Complete lower-face binding candidate and second visual pass required.

Actually inspected all 24 enlarged source/battle face and complete-body front/side sheets: all 13 clips at six phases. Ember Ocelot eyes and headband remain stable while the white chin/lower lip is subtly drawn toward the scarf during idle_2, jump, hit and death. Both assets have non-head influences in independent muzzle/lower-face/side-jaw patches. Whiskers, four legs, paws, torso and tail remain coherent; scarf and head ties must retain their motion. Face candidate and second visual pass required.

All 24 baseline views and five targeted 960px source chest captures actually inspected. Chest strips elongate and pinch in jump/hit/entrance/attack. Targeted source chest edges stretch 9.8076x in jump, 10.2544x in hit, 10.9381x in attack due to abrupt head/wing/spine/chest palette changes. The separately visually inspected battle binding is smoother (corresponding regional peak 3.3048x) and retains the same rig. Project its pinned binding onto the detailed sculpt as a separate candidate; require full geometry, independent face tests and complete visual recheck before acceptance.

All 24 baseline face/body views actually inspected. Corrected side cheek patch repicked above the mobile scarf and final overlay actually inspected: 81 source cheek vertices, brown side skin rather than scarf. Front lower mouth and side cheek need separate height/front fades to preserve the cloth below. Face probe fails even after cloth boundary correction. Compare candidate and scarf motion before acceptance. First candidate rejected: tight front chin fade introduced up to 14.96x stretches along the lower mouth boundary. Second candidate widens the face-to-cloth transition below the chin while leaving lower scarf motion outside the mask.

Actually inspected all 24 enlarged source/battle face and complete-body front/side sheets: all 13 clips at six phases. Blaze Caracal lower jaw and muzzle sides shear relative to the eyes during idle_2, jump, hit, death and victory; the cheek bulges beneath the ear during death tilt and the side jaw pulls into the scarf. Both assets reproduce the defect. Ears, tuft tips, four legs, paws, torso, white chest tuft, tail and separate flank flame remain coherent. Complete-face binding candidate must preserve scarf movement; second visual pass required.
